description: This header file declares functions and types related to managing hostapd configurations, such as loading, creating, deleting, and modifying configuration data for wireless access points. It includes external type definitions, function prototypes, and macro guards.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_loadConfig
methods.description: Loads hostapd configuration from a specified file path into a configuration structure.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_createConfig
methods.description: Creates a new hostapd configuration object, possibly associated with a radio interface.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_deleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes a hostapd configuration object and frees associated resources.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes a hostapd configuration object to a specified file path.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_addConfigParam
methods.description: Adds a configuration parameter specified by key and value to a given BSS section in the configuration.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_delConfigParam
methods.description: Removes a configuration parameter identified by key from a specified BSS section.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigMap
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration parameters map for a given BSS name.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigParamValStr
methods.description: Retrieves the string value of a configuration parameter for a specified BSS.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigMapByBssid
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration parameters map for a specific BSSID.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigParamByBssidValStr
methods.description: Fetches the string value of a specific configuration parameter for a given BSSID.
